verdict.rationale: Iter 0 fix (ct passed to DeleteExpiredAsync). Iter 1 remaining blockers all PLAN_ASSUMPTION_WRONG: (CQ8) Codex claims RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate with j.RunAsync(CancellationToken.None) loses graceful shutdown — wrong. Hangfire deserializes the expression and automatically substitutes the CancellationToken parameter with its runtime IJobCancellationToken.ShutdownToken (documented library behavior). Same pattern used in Faz 1 Appointments/Automation (merged, running in prod). (CQ1/CQ12) Codex insists on seeing INV-JOB-005 emission in this diff; emission is done by FinalFailureLogger registered in Invekto.Shared/Hosting/HangfireSetup.cs (Faz 1, not in this PR). CoVe Q1/Q2/Q3/Q5 all PASS; Q4 only UNKNOWN on the same cross-diff visibility issue.
